clauses.sentence: The Initial Subscription Term begins on the Effective Date and continues for thirty-six (36) months, and Customer may not terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time during the Initial Subscription Term.
clauses.statement: The contract runs for 36 months from the Effective Date, and you can’t end it for convenience during that time.

exposure.exitDifficulty: Customer may not terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time during the Initial Subscription Term

clauses.why: The buyer cannot leave before a cited period of 36 months.

clauses.sentence: Upon expiration of the Initial Subscription Term or any renewal term, this Agreement shall automatically renew at the Subscription Fee then in effect, which for the first renewal term shall be no less than $48,000 per year.
clauses.statement: When a term ends, the contract renews on its own at the fee then in effect, which is at least $48,000 a year for the first renewal.
clauses.why: The agreement renews on its own for a cited amount of at least $48,000 per year.

clauses.sentence: Each renewal term shall be equal in length to the Initial Subscription Term of thirty-six (36) months.
clauses.statement: Every renewal term runs for 36 months, the same length as the first term.
clauses.why: Each renewal runs for a term as long as the original 36-month term.

clauses.sentence: To prevent renewal, Customer must deliver written notice of non-renewal by certified mail to Provider's legal department, and that notice must be received no later than ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.
clauses.statement: To stop a renewal, you have to send written notice by certified mail to Provider’s legal department, and it has to arrive at least 90 days before the current term ends.

exposure.exitDifficulty: no later than ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term

clauses.why: The notice method (written, by certified mail) and period (90 days) are stated, and the deadline falls before the renewal.

clauses.sentence: If Customer terminates this Agreement for convenience during any renewal term, Customer shall pay Provider an early termination fee equal to one hundred percent (100%) of the Subscription Fees remaining for the balance of that renewal term.
clauses.statement: If you end the contract for convenience during a renewal term, you owe every Subscription Fee left in that term.

exposure.money: one hundred percent (100%) of the Subscription Fees remaining for the balance of that renewal term

clauses.why: The clause cites a formula for the fee: all Subscription Fees left in the renewal term.

clauses.sentence: If Customer purchases additional Authorized User seats during any term, the subscription for those seats and the existing Services shall be coterminous and shall renew together for a full renewal term.
clauses.statement: Seats you add during a term are tied to the existing subscription and renew with it for a full renewal term.
readings: The added seats end on the existing term's end date, and then all seats renew together for one renewal term.
Buying seats restarts the whole subscription, so the existing Services run on to the end of a new full term alongside the added seats.
clauses.why: The clause reads two ways, and under one reading buying seats restarts the lock-in, so it goes in the top tier by ADR 0005.

clauses.sentence: The Priority Support add-on renews together with the Services, and Customer can cancel the Priority Support add-on at any time without charge from the billing page of its account.
clauses.statement: The Priority Support add-on renews with the Services, and you can cancel it at any time without charge from the billing page of your account.
clauses.why: The add-on renews on its own, but the clause cites no sum, period or fee, and the buyer cancels it at any time without charge.

summary.sentence: This Master Subscription Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of March 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Halvard Cloud Systems, Inc., a Delaware corporation with offices at 400 Larkspur Avenue, Suite 1200, Wilmington, Delaware 19801 ("Provider"), and Brightwater Bakery Supply LLC, an Oregon limited liability company with offices at 77 Mill Street, Bend, Oregon 97701 ("Customer").
summary.point: This is a subscription agreement between Halvard Cloud Systems, Inc. (the Provider) and Brightwater Bakery Supply LLC (the Customer), dated March 1, 2026.

summary.sentence: Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right during the Subscription Term to permit up to twenty-five (25) Authorized Users to access and use the Services for Customer's internal business purposes.
summary.point: Up to 25 named users at your business can use the Services for your internal business purposes.

summary.sentence: The Initial Subscription Term begins on the Effective Date and continues for thirty-six (36) months, and Customer may not terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time during the Initial Subscription Term.
summary.point: The first term runs for 36 months from the Effective Date, and you can’t end the agreement for convenience during it.

summary.sentence: Upon expiration of the Initial Subscription Term or any renewal term, this Agreement shall automatically renew at the Subscription Fee then in effect, which for the first renewal term shall be no less than $48,000 per year.
summary.point: When a term ends, the agreement renews on its own, and the first renewal costs at least $48,000 a year.

summary.sentence: To prevent renewal, Customer must deliver written notice of non-renewal by certified mail to Provider's legal department, and that notice must be received no later than ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.
summary.point: To stop a renewal, you have to send written notice by certified mail to Provider’s legal department, and it has to arrive at least 90 days before the current term ends.

summary.sentence: The Subscription Fee for the Initial Subscription Term is $42,000 per year, payable annually in advance on the Effective Date and on each anniversary of the Effective Date.
summary.point: For the first term you pay $42,000 a year, in advance, on the Effective Date and on each anniversary of it.

summary.sentence: Provider may increase the Subscription Fees for any renewal term by up to nine percent (9%) over the Subscription Fees for the prior term, by giving Customer notice of the increase at least thirty (30) days before the renewal term begins.
summary.point: Provider can raise the fees for a renewal term by up to 9% over the prior term, if it tells you at least 30 days before that term begins.

summary.sentence: In no event shall Provider's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement exceed the Subscription Fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
summary.point: Provider’s total liability under the agreement is capped at the Subscription Fees you paid in the 12 months before the event behind the claim.

decoys.why: Termination for breach carries no fee and sets no lock-in, so it is none of the five clause types.
